description:
Front End Developer 
   
   
   Skilled in creating a visually accurate, functional web application from a Photoshop document 
   UI/UX implementations experience, portfolio desired 
   Experience implementing Responsive designs (adjusting to desktop vs. tablet vs. mobile displays) 
   Reactive design, as in smooth two-way event flow as in React.js, Angular.js, Backbone.js, Ember.js 
   HTML/CSS (SASS is a plus, SEO is a plus) 
  JavaScript/JQuery

 
   Web Application experience - using templates and dynamic content on top of a web application framework such as one of the following: 
      Java/Tomcat 
      Ruby on Rails 
      Python/Pyramid 
      Microsoft MVC 3

 
  Web Templating experience - using templates to render web pages, such as: 
      Mako 
      Chameleon/ZPT/Genshi 
      Haml 
      Mustache 
      React 
     Ember 
 
 

 Local to Dallas or from surrounding areas - Within Texas and Oklahoma. 

 Apply today!
